correctness.rationale: Rank-two quinary projective directions give exactly six multiplicities and weights N-m_i, repeated four times. The enumerator fixes N via total weight 20N. PGL2(5) has 120 elements with explicitly established seven cycle-type counts. Burnside yields all eleven class counts, multiplicity minima 6/10/15 give all-length thresholds (with zero-coordinate padding), and an explicit 6-column pair has exactly 36/25 distortion by matching upper and lower bounds. Standalone checker directly enumerates the 120 maps, all equality patterns in two ways, both 25-word spectra and all candidate distortions. Finite computation corroborates, not substitutes for, the general proof.
